name: Rhode Island
agency: Rhode Island Division of Motor Vehicles (RI DMV)
permitAge: 16 (limited instruction permit, ages 16 to 18), after a 33-hour driver education course

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including 10 at night, certified by parent or guardian (RIGL 31-10-6)
teen.nightLimit: Limited provisional license: no driving 1 a.m. to 5 a.m. without a qualified adult, except documented work or school trips and medical emergencies (secondary)
teen.passengerLimit: First 12 months of limited provisional license: no more than one passenger under 21, immediate family excluded (RIGL 31-10-6)
teen.phone: All drivers: texting banned; hand-held calls banned, hands-free allowed for adults. Under-18 total ban reported by one secondary source only, not used.

notes: Knowledge test length and pass mark conflict between third-party sites (50 questions / 80 percent vs 40 / 70 percent). Left null.
Computerized knowledge exam given in English, Spanish and Portuguese; printed exams in other languages on request (RI DMV knowledge-exams page).
Permit test: part of the CCRI driver education course, otherwise at DMV headquarters in Cranston (secondary). Parent, guardian or adult spouse co-signs.
Permit supervisor: licensed adult over 21, licensed at least 5 years (secondary, not confirmed in statute).

Move over (RISP): change lanes or slow down for stopped police, fire, ambulance, tow truck, utility, highway maintenance and similar vehicles showing lights; 2023 expansion to all vehicles not confirmed.

School bus (RIGL 31-20-13): no stop required for a bus on the other side of a divided highway (median strip); undivided roads: both directions stop, including center turn lane (school district summary).
Official driver's manual URL (English and Spanish) not found in search; a Spanish edition is reported by secondary sites.
